object.name: evi_hzpitchmods
object.digest: Modulation helper for filters and oscillators
object.description: A curious but useful (and expensive) modulation helper for oscillators and filters requiring FM control of frequency. The main cutoff frequency can be optionally smoothed, scaled, FM-ed with a pitch signal and FM-ed with a Hz signal.

inlets.name: cutoff
inlets.digest: The required cutoff frequency, units depend on the @mode attribute, by default this is in Pitch.

inlets.name: pitch
inlets.digest: FM signal in Pitch units. This FMs the inlet 1 cutoff value if selected. This inlet is ignored if @mode == 0

inlets.name: hz
inlets.digest: FM signal in Hz units. This FMs the inlet 1 cutoff value if selected. This operates regardless of the @mode attribute.

outlets.name: fm-ed\,
outlets.digest: The output cutoff value in Hz, to be passed onto downstream filter or oscillator processes, post smoothing and FM controls.

outlets.name: hz
outlets.digest: The high limit value in Hz that has been requested (factor of @high attribute and samplerate).

attributes.name: cliplimit
attributes.description: If on (1), the frequency output is limited as a product of the @high attribute and samplerate; this can be useful for oscillators that are bandlimited only to a certain frequency. If off (0), frequency output is limited to samplerate * 0.5.

attributes.name: high
attributes.description: A multiplier of samplerate, 0..0.5, frequency output is high clipped to this if @cliplimit == 1

attributes.name: low
attributes.description: In Hz, the frequency output is low clipped to this value (unless the result of the @high calculation is lower).

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: If mode == 1, inlet 1 is required to be in Pitch values (the default). If mode == 0, inlet 1 is required to be in Hz values and inlet 2 (pitch) is ignored.

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Smoothing time in ms of the main cutoff frequency. By default this is off (0.). If > 0., the curoff is smoothed using a smoother chosen by the @smoothtype attribute. If selected, smoothing takes place before the pitch and/or frequency modulation signals.

attributes.name: smoothtype
attributes.description: Select the type of smoother used to smooth the main cutoff frequency (before FM) if the @smooth attribute is > 0. 0=evi_cfsmooth (default), 1=evi_logsmooth, 2=evi_line, 3=evi_sline, 4=evi_lagsmooth.

attributes.name: tuning
attributes.description: The base cutoff tuning (of embedded evi_mtofapprox) in Hz, default 440 Hz. This affects the Pitch modulation only, if @mode == 1.
